caption.text:
Windows has been selling YOUR
internet to strangers 😭🍺

Even Stewie didn't know this 💀

Every Windows 10 and 11 PC
does this by default
Since the day you installed it
Microsoft never told you

Fix it in 5 clicks:
Settings → Windows Update
→ Advanced Options
→ Delivery Optimisation
→ Toggle OFF

Comment ROBBED below 👇
Peter drops the fix in replies

Secret 1 of 4 🍺
Secret 2 is even worse 👀

Follow so you don't miss it
